title: Senior GTM Insights Automation Manager
location: Chicago, IL; Los Angeles, CA; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 Reddit is looking for a solution builder focused on Go-to-market Insights and Automation to join our Central Operations team. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our data-driven Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy. You will design and implement workflows that automate our reporting ecosystem, ensuring that our sales teams have the insights they need to succeed without the manual overhead.
 As a member of Central Ops, you will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and technical execution, working across a sophisticated tool stack to solve real-world operational challenges.
 Location: Must be based within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York
 Responsibilities:
 Execute Technical Builds: Perform the technical work required to build within and across our core tools (such as BigQuery, Matik, Clay, Gong, and others) to achieve automated reporting objectives. Lead the design and development of sales data models using SQL. Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines.
 Collaborate with sales and business stakeholders to understand their data requirements and deliver actionable insights.
 Align with Business Metrics: Act as a technical partner to ensure all reporting builds align with measurable business objectives, such as "saving Account Managers time" or improving forecast accuracy.
 Establish Governance: Work with Product Owners to define and implement best practice "recipes" for tool usage and reporting consistency across the organization.

title: Fraud and Risk Specialist
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Trust and confidence is fundamental to the Lyft marketplace, and the Fraud and Risk Analytics team is charged with providing and ensuring that trust and safety to all customers. The Fraud and Risk Analytics team is one of the most critical teams that helps protect Lyft and enables the company to grow in a sustainable way. The team is fast-paced, high-energy, and meticulous in diagnosing emerging fraud patterns and preventing fraud loss before it can happen. We drill holes in all the products we launch and obsess over how to make our business impervious to fraud vectors. The team conducts a rigorous analysis of complex data sets and sets up multiple layers of business rules, models, and other processes to prevent potential fraud. We are a highly cross-functional team and regularly engage in discussion and reviews with stakeholders to prioritize plans for reducing fraud impact and introducing safety features.
 We’re looking for a rock-star to join a fast-paced environment to contribute to Fraud-related analysis and operations. This individual is responsible for investigating and developing solutions to prevent and mitigate third party fraud. This person will proactively identify fraud patterns and sources to minimize the company’s exposure to financial and reputational risk.
 This person is quantitatively driven, detail-focused, and operations-savvy while ensuring the best possible customer experience. This individual possesses a high level of subject matter expertise and is experienced in utilizing information generated from fraud patterns, data analytics and business knowledge to identify insights and formulate a response plan. title: Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
description:
Who we are
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .
 Hiring and how we work
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .
 See yourself at Twilio
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
 About the job
 This position is needed as Twilio continues to grow rapidly. As the Senior Manager, Accounts Payable, you will oversee Twilio’s global Accounts Payable function, leading operational execution and process excellence across vendor disbursements, expense management, and AP support. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of International Accounting, you will play a critical role in scaling our finance operations, driving automation, ensuring compliance, and supporting both organic and inorganic growth.
 Responsibilities
 In this role, you’ll:
 Lead the daily operations of global Accounts Payable, vendor disbursements, expense management, and credit card reconciliations.
 Manage and mentor a high performing AP team, setting clear KPIs, performance benchmarks, and professional development plans.

title: Regional Sales Operations Manager - NAMER (Remote)
description:
Role Description
 We are looking for a data-driven, systems-thinking Sales Operations Manager to own the operating infrastructure that powers our go-to-market engine. In this highly visible Individual Contributor role, you will serve as the backbone of a regional Sales organization and translate go-to-market strategy into an executable operating model.
 You will act as the primary regional business partner for sales executives , supporting all routes to market within the region. You will own or coordinate supporting sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans .
 You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations.
 Your top priority each day will be to ensure excellence in execution and reporting on our regional goals.
 Responsibilities
 Own the operating cadence, including territory management, account segmentation, forecasting governance, pipeline inspection, business reviews, and performance visibility, delivering executive-ready insights that drive forecast accuracy, balanced sales coverage, and operational excellence .Partner with regional Sales leaders across all routes to market to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, sales coverage, deal quality, and operational execution.
 Work in close partnership with the Chief Business Officer’s organization and the GTM Strategy & Programs team to connect regional Sales Operations to company-wide priorities, provide timely inputs for executive reporting, and ensure consistency across regional and corporate operating cadences.
